# Microsoft Graph API Gotchas

> Known Microsoft Graph API patterns that cause silent failures, auth errors, or data loss. Load all HIGH entries before writing any Graph API code.

## Entries

- [Certificate must be in CurrentUser store](cert-auth.md): Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My -- not LocalMachine. Verify cert exists before connecting. HIGH.
- [Always Disconnect-MgGraph in finally block](disconnect-finally.md): Stale connections leave tokens active. Always disconnect in finally even if the script throws. HIGH.
- [403 = missing admin consent, not missing permission](403-admin-consent.md): The permission may be listed in the app registration but admin consent was never granted. Check role assignments, not just permission declarations. MEDIUM.
- [New permissions take 1-15 min to propagate](permission-propagation.md): After granting admin consent, disconnect and reconnect. Existing token won't have new scopes. Poll before proceeding. HIGH.
- [KeyCredentials: use cert RawData and cert dates](key-credentials.md): Use $cert.RawData directly (not base64 then ASCII bytes). Use $cert.NotBefore/$cert.NotAfter (not UtcNow). Use -KeyCredentials with PascalCase (not -BodyParameter camelCase). HIGH.
- [Always use -All or follow @odata.nextLink](pagination.md): Default page size is 999 items. Omitting -All silently truncates results. HIGH.
- [Exchange Online needs Exchange.ManageAsApp + Exchange Admin role + domain not GUID](exchange-online.md): Graph permissions alone are insufficient. Requires both the app permission and the directory role. Connect-ExchangeOnline -Organization takes a domain name, not a GUID. HIGH.
- [URL-encode single quotes as %27 in filter queries](filter-encoding.md): Bare single quotes in $filter strings cause BadRequest or type mismatch errors. MEDIUM.
- [PATCH CA policy: send full conditions.users object](ca-policy-patch.md): Sending only excludeUsers in a PATCH silently clears includeUsers. Read current policy first and include all fields. HIGH.
- [CA policy PATCH fails with 1007: strip null fields and keep arrays array-shaped](ca-policy-patch-1007-schema.md): Echoing null complex fields (locations/platforms/devices/clientApplications/etc.) back, or letting PowerShell collapse single-element arrays to scalars, both yield "1007 ... does not match the schema". Strip nulls; use unary comma on function returns and [string[]] casts on assignments. HIGH.
- [429/503: Invoke-MgGraphRequest does not auto-retry](throttling.md): The SDK auto-handles throttling but Invoke-MgGraphRequest does not. Add retry logic with Retry-After header. MEDIUM.
- [Channel creation is async -- poll before accessing files](channel-provisioning.md): New channel file folders are not immediately available. Poll Get-MgTeamChannelFileFolder until it succeeds. MEDIUM.
- [Large file uploads need upload sessions (over 4MB)](file-uploads.md): Direct PUT fails for files over 4MB. Use createUploadSession for large files. MEDIUM.
- [Private channels have separate SharePoint sites](private-channels.md): Private channel files are not accessible through the parent team's drive. Use Get-MgTeamChannelFileFolder to get the correct drive reference. HIGH.
- [Conditional Access operations require extra permissions](conditional-access.md): Standard app registrations don't include CA scopes. Sign-in log CA details are redacted without Policy.Read.All. Error codes: 53003 (CA block), 50076 (MFA), 530003 (non-compliant device). MEDIUM.
- [OneDrive search requires Sites.ReadWrite.All](onedrive-search-permissions.md): Search endpoint is SharePoint-backed. Files.ReadWrite.All handles CRUD but search returns 403 without Sites.ReadWrite.All. MEDIUM.
- [@odata.type cannot be used in $select queries](odata-type-in-select.md): Including @odata.type in $select causes 400 Bad Request. It is returned automatically -- just omit it from $select and access it in the response. MEDIUM.
- [DirSync-synced objects block cloud-side Exchange attribute changes](dirsync-blocks-cloud-writes.md): HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled and other Exchange attributes mastered on-prem cannot be set via EXO or Graph for DirSync users. Set msExchHideFromAddressLists in on-prem AD instead. HIGH.
- [Stale tenant Graph SP missing newer app roles](stale-graph-sp-app-roles.md): Older tenants have a stale Microsoft Graph service principal that does not include newer app role IDs. Consent fails with "Claim is invalid" / "Permission being assigned was not found on application" from portal, SDK, and API. Diagnose via $graphSp.AppRoles count and ID lookup; fix by dropping unavailable permissions from the app registration. HIGH.
- [proxyAddresses is read-only via Graph for mail-enabled users](proxyaddresses-readonly.md): PATCH /users/{id} with a new proxyAddresses collection returns "Property 'proxyAddresses' is read-only and cannot be set" once the user has an Exchange mailbox. Email aliases must be added/removed via Set-Mailbox -EmailAddresses @{Add/Remove=...}. Graph CAN update mailNickname which auto-flips primary SMTP, but cannot edit aliases. HIGH.
- [Connect-MgGraph -UseDeviceCode + Invoke-MgGraphRequest = NRE](connect-mggraph-devicecode-nre.md): Device-code sign-in completes ("Welcome to Microsoft Graph!") but the next Invoke-MgGraphRequest throws "DeviceCodeCredential authentication failed: Object reference not set to an instance of an object". Bypass with MSAL.PS + Invoke-RestMethod, or use typed Get-Mg* cmdlets. HIGH.
- [/chats/getAllMessages returns 412 without Teams Protected APIs onboarding](getallmessages-protected-apis-412.md): The bulk message-streaming endpoints require tenant onboarding to Teams Protected APIs with an active billing model. ?model=B is necessary but not sufficient. Most tenants must enumerate per-chat (/me/chats then /chats/{id}/messages) instead. HIGH.
- [POST /oauth2PermissionGrants needs DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All](oauth2grants-need-delegated-permission-grant.md): Microsoft docs still list Directory.ReadWrite.All as sufficient, but in practice only DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All grants 403-free writes. Affects any cert-auth automation that grants tenant-wide consent on behalf of another SP. HIGH.
- [Exchange Online directory has propagation lag after Graph user creation](exo-directory-lag-after-graph-create.md): Right after POST /users, EXO recipient cmdlets (Add-DistributionGroupMember, Set-Mailbox, Add-MailboxFolderPermission) fail with "Couldn't find object" for 30-120s. Fix is ordering, not retries: do all Graph work first, poll Get-Mailbox as the EXO sync gate, then do EXO ops. HIGH.
- [Graph /drive/root/invite is blocked on OneDrive default doc library](onedrive-invite-blocked-on-default-library.md): POST /drives/{id}/root/invite returns 400 "Sharing or permission updating on the default document library is not supported in OneDrive." regardless of Graph permissions. Must use SharePoint admin API with Sites.FullControl.All (SharePoint resource 00000003-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000) and Add-PnPSiteCollectionAdmin instead. HIGH.
- [App-only Graph cannot read inbox rules](app-only-cannot-read-inbox-rules.md): GET .../mailFolders/inbox/messageRules returns 403 under app-only auth even with Mail.ReadWrite -- messageRules is delegated-only. Use Exchange Online Get-InboxRule instead. HIGH.
- [Search-UnifiedAuditLog needs the Compliance Administrator role](unified-audit-log-needs-compliance-admin.md): App-only EXO connects under Global Reader but the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet is absent from the session -- the cmdlet surface is RBAC-gated. Assign Compliance Administrator (plus Exchange.ManageAsApp + consent), not Global Reader. HIGH.
- [A principal cannot remove itself from a directory role](principal-cannot-remove-self-from-role.md): DELETE role member $ref returns 400 "remove self from <Role> role" when the caller is the role member. App-only automation that self-elevates cannot strip the role with its own creds; a different admin principal must do it. HIGH.
- [Assigning an SP to a directory role needs RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory](assign-sp-to-role-needs-rolemanagement-readwrite.md): POST /directoryRoles/{id}/members/$ref returns 403 Authorization_RequestDenied with only Directory.ReadWrite.All. RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory is required. HIGH.
- [IMAP MailItemsAccessed carries no AppId](imap-mailbox-access-attribution.md): IMAP mailbox-audit records have an empty AppId, and the default signIns feed hides background app logins. Attribute OAuth/IMAP app access by querying non-interactive sign-ins (signInEventTypes/any) filtered to Office 365 Exchange Online. HIGH.
- [Graph user PATCH then immediate GET returns stale value (read-after-write lag)](read-after-write-lag.md): After Update-MgUser succeeds, an immediate Get-MgUser of the same property can read the old value off a lagging replica. Inconsistent split across a bulk loop is the tell. Don't treat it as a failed write; verify in a separate pass after a short delay. MEDIUM.
